headline: Kyrgyzstan's hotels and restaurants earned 60.3 billion soms in 10 months
summary: Hotels and restaurants in Kyrgyzstan provided services worth 60.394 billion soms from January to October 2026. The figure was reported by the National Statistical Committee.
why: Hotel and restaurant revenue is a gauge of domestic consumer spending and tourism activity. Such services data helps assess services sector growth in a small economy.
original_headline: Гостиницы и рестораны Кыргызстана заработали 60,3 миллиарда сомов за 10 месяцев
